title: Desiderio l’Abbé to Nevers, Prague and Breslau, 1577

steps.what: Resumed existing local notes and IIIF scans; earlier Prague cipher transcription incomplete. Regenerated native-scale crops.
Inspected Breslau cipher at native scale; numeral order and digit grouping require renewed analysis. Earlier notes are unverified prior project work, not an independent decipherment.
Transcribed sixteen Prague recto insertions and May cipher into runs_draft.json; glyph and grouping uncertainties retained.
Tested 63 greedy one/two-digit prefix partitions. Unrestricted homophonic scoring collapsed to repeated letters; constrained swaps produced no coherent text. Testing point-delimited pairs next.
Swept 1566 retained forward/backward greedy prefix segmentations on the frozen initial draft; six pair variants and pointed-six null variants gave no coherent manuscript plaintext.
Expanded to 29 Prague insertions plus the two May spans; measured 834 and 77 draft digits. Rechecked f64 lower cipher against its repeated view on f65.
Imposed hypothetical mais...jamais, then ne/ni, in point-delimited pair parses of May. No coherent extension; all crib mappings rejected as unvalidated.
Constrained pair substitution solver recovered 538 of 538 synthetic plaintext letters. This verifies the restricted implementation, not the manuscript model. See control/result.tsv.
Read f63 reference to sending a copy of the cipher by one of two routes on 24 February to Sr Barquin (name provisional). Corrected par lune, previously misread as a place.
Located catalogue mirror for fr. 4695 no. 51, Labbe to Nevers, Prague 5 February 1577, Gallica btv1b90582923; plausible earlier correspondence, not inspected and not a demonstrated key enclosure.
New Gallica image/manifest requests failed by connection reset or timeout via Python, curl and browser; earlier-letter/enclosure trail remains externally blocked.

outcome.fraction_read_source: All cipher insertions remain unvalidated; clear prose and imposed cribs excluded. Cipher-token boundaries remain unknown.

gaps.detail: No validated values or segmentation; draft only.
f64r08 obscured locus and unresolved glyph variants.

gaps.item: Earlier letter/enclosure trail in fr. 4695 no. 51
gaps.detail: Digital access currently fails; restored images or another copy needed, not necessarily an in-person visit.

outcome.notes: Attempt closed for now; research target remains open. No claim of cryptographic impossibility and no partial-solve percentage based on clear prose. See REASSESSMENT.md.

human: Identified manuscript and requested solving to completion.
